## Summary

- Adds `openai@^6.39.0` to `package.json` dependencies
- Replaces raw `fetch` calls in `getHtmlFromOpenAI.ts`, `getCodeFromOpenAI.ts`, and `getInterpretationFromAI.ts` with the official OpenAI SDK (`client.chat.completions.create`)
- Upgrades deprecated `gpt-4-vision-preview` → `gpt-4o` in `getHtmlFromOpenAI.ts`
- Fixes `generateCode.tsx` and `interpretShapes.tsx` to remove stale `json.error` checks (SDK throws on API errors) and handle `null`-safe content via `?? ''`

## Test plan

- [ ] `npm install` completes without dependency errors
- [ ] TypeScript build (`npx tsc --noEmit`) passes with no errors
- [ ] All three OpenAI functions use the SDK client with `dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true`
- [ ] No references to `gpt-4-vision-preview` remain in the codebase
- [ ] No raw `fetch` calls to `api.openai.com` remain in lib files

Closes #4
